note: Read by tools/restructure/move.mjs. `homes`: the folder of a feature when it is not named like the feature (structure-conventions, section 2: `ai-local.js` goes to `server/ai/`). `features` and `files`: loose files of `server/` that stay where they are on purpose, each with the reason the report prints.

features.updates: the updater: installers and the app's bootstrap name these files, and an install replaces them while it runs them

files.server/remote-access.js: the gate lists of paired devices and the order of their checks: every note and review points at this path
files.server/disk-categories.js: the closed list of what may be deleted: left alone with the gate lists
files.server/linux-collectors.js: shared by many features (structure-conventions, section 5: collectors keep their paths)
files.server/darwin-collectors.js: shared by many features (structure-conventions, section 5: collectors keep their paths)
